{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check unique values in customer_segment and status
unique_segments = sales_df['customer_segment'].unique()
unique_status = sales_df['status'].unique()

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue for these orders
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Check if any rows were found
count_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

unique_segments, unique_status, mean_revenue, count_loyal_completed"}
